profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack engineer with experience teaching tech courses in a school setting. I currently work as a Software Engineer at Capital One, where I solve complex problems, learn new technologies, and help others. I have a Master of Educational Technology Leadership, a Bachelor of Computer Information Systems, and a Bachelor of Science in Education, which give me a solid foundation in both education and technology.

My skillset includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Kotlin, SQL, Git, SVN, Python, Jira, Docker, NodeJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS RDS, AWS Aurora, Dynamo Db, Serverless Architecture, Slack API, IAC, and CI/CD. In my previous roles, I have designed and delivered highly engaging learning experiences, managed and executed multiple web development projects, and established and led an Academy of Information Technology. I hold several certifications, including AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Certified Secure Software Engineer – Associate, IT Specialist – Python, and MTA: Introduction to Programming Using HTML and CSS. I am passionate about learning, growing, and making a positive impact through my skills and experience.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
- Taught Advanced Placement Computer Science Principles and Advanced Placement Computer Science A.
- Instructed classes in Python, and Java.
- Observed, managed, documented, and reported student progress.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Dedicated and efficient full stack developer with 10+ years of experience in building web applications on a LAMP server setup. Demonstrated ability to deliver a project within a prescribed timeline with an expected level of quality.

positions.title: Academy of IT Director, Dual Credit Information Technology Instructor
positions.locationName: Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship Academy High School
positions.description:
Dual Credit Teacher	Dallas ISD/Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship Academy High School
August 2018 – Current
•	Developed curriculum and instructional materials required for me to teach the following college courses:  Introduction to Digital Media and Web Design I
•	Building an Information Technology pathway from scratch that will result in students graduating high school with a certificate in Web Development from El Centro College  
•	Utilized screen recording software including Screencastify and Camtasia to create how to videos and recorded lectures. Topics covered include Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, Premiere, Animate, App Inventor, and creating websites with HTML, CSS, and Javascript.   
•	Integrate project-based learning and design thinking to increase student engagement.
•	Prepare students to master the Advance Placement Computer Science Principles Exam  

Teacher 	Dallas ISD/Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship Academy High School
August 2015 – June 2018
•	Plan lessons to meet the needs of a diverse grouping of students
•	Conduct home visits to strengthen communication between parents and school
•	Integrate programming, project-based learning, design thinking and lean startup techniques to engage students in developing solutions to solve problems in their community
•	Plan and implement a schoolwide event to showcase Android Apps and business plans created by students 
•	Mentor and facilitate the growth of new teachers in the implementation of personalized learning/blended learning including student voice and choice, data-based groupings, station rotation, and project-based learning
•	Write curriculum and create digital resources to be accessed through Schoology, a learning management system.
•	Research and integrate technology to increase student engagement and student success.  
•	Teaches Web Technologies, Co-teacher in Digital Design and Media Production
•	Received Distinguished Teacher Rating and 2017 Campus Teacher of the Year

positions.title: Department Chair and Teacher
positions.description:
•	Utilized Moodle and Edmodo, learning management systems and integrated other technologies
•	Teaches Technology Applications, Touch Systems Data Entry, and Advanced Technology Applications 
•	Communication liaison between the elective department and the administrative staff.  
•	Schedule and lead regular department meetings, with organized minutes and agenda.

positions.title: Trainer
positions.description:
•	Created and conducted professional development in effective use of technology to improve student engagement and performance.
•	Created and conducted professional development for district employees, from Administrators to Office Staff, to use various types of technology to improve professional practice.

positions.title: Technical Trainer
positions.description:
•	Participated in train-the-trainer sessions & obtain in-depth understanding of content for targeted audience translation. 
•	Delivered and facilitated courses for multiple employee audiences. 
•	Taught and trained internal employees on internal and out of box software and new processes.
